title: Step 2 - Building a K-Nearest Neighbors Model: Scikit-Learn KNeighborsClassifier

cues.en: -: All right, so that was the name of the module you had to find.
cues.zh: 這就是要找的模組名稱。

cues.en: And now the next question is, which of these classes, because you see these are all the classes of this neighbors module.
cues.zh: 接著問題是，這些都是 neighbors 模組中的類別，要選哪個？

cues.en: That's actually the name of the module by site, Learn Neighbors.
cues.zh: 模組全名是 sklearn.neighbors。

cues.en: And these are all the classes that allow you to build machine learning tools, ya know in this nearest neighbors branch of machine learning.
cues.zh: 這些類別可建立最近鄰分支中的各種機器學習工具。

cues.en: All right, so of course the one we are interested in is this one, KNeighborsClassifier.
cues.zh: 當然，我們需要 KNeighborsClassifier。

cues.en: There you go, congratulations if you found it.
cues.zh: 找到了的話，恭喜。

cues.en: So, let's click it, and let's see the whole documentation.
cues.zh: 點進去，看完整文件。

cues.en: So feel free to read it if you want, you can see what our old parameters and also attributes, but what we actually simply need is this.
cues.zh: 可以自行閱讀所有參數與屬性，但真正需要的只是這裡。

cues.en: The whole name of the class and the module and the library site Learn because the only thing that we need, really, to build and train this K-NN model is the name of this class to,
cues.zh: 類別、模組與 sklearn 名稱。要建立並訓練 KNN，只需知道類別名稱，

cues.en: you know, create the object and also the parameters here.
cues.zh: 用來建立物件，以及這裡的參數。

cues.en: We need to know which parameters we have to enter here in order to build a relevant K-NN model.
cues.zh: 要知道哪些參數能建立合適模型。

cues.en: All right, so first let's take this and let's go back to our implementation to here, paste it and then adapt it by, you know, doing this from- from psych learn.
cues.zh: 先複製這段，回到實作，貼上並改成 from sklearn。

cues.en: And then from the neighbors module of psych learn we will import this class.
cues.zh: 從 sklearn.neighbors 匯入這個類別。

cues.en: The KNeighborsClassifier, that's the class.
cues.zh: KNeighborsClassifier。

cues.en: And then, you know, the next natural step it is to create an object of this class which will represent exactly the K-NN model model itself, the classifier.
cues.zh: 下一步自然是建立它的物件，代表 KNN 模型，也就是分類器。

cues.en: And that's why we call it classifier.
cues.zh: 所以命名為 classifier。

cues.en: And then to create an object of this class, well we just need to call the class again.
cues.zh: 要建立物件，只需再次呼叫類別。

cues.en: So I'm copying this, pacing it here, and then adding some parentheses.
cues.zh: 複製貼上，再加括號。

cues.en: All right, so that's the first information we need to get from the cycler API.
cues.zh: 這是從 API 要取得的第一個資訊。

cues.en: But then, the second thing we need to check also are the parameters here, and you have all the descriptions here.
cues.zh: 第二個則是參數，下方有全部說明。

cues.en: So for example, the first one, n_neighbors = 5 n_neighbors is of course the number of neighbors of your K-NN model.
cues.zh: 例如 n_neighbors=5，當然就是 KNN 鄰居數。

cues.en: You remember the intuition lectures, you have the neighbors that you use to make your predictions and we have to choose a number of neighbors and well, you know, we can just try this value five.
cues.zh: 記得直覺教學，預測需要鄰居，所以要選數量。先試 5。

cues.en: I actually know that we will get good results with this but you know, in your future machinery projects if you're using the K-NN model, well, I recommend to tune it with several values, but five is usually good.
cues.zh: 我知道這裡會很好，但未來專案建議用多個值調整；5 通常不錯。

cues.en: So let's do this first parameter, n_neighbors = 5.
cues.zh: 第一個參數 n_neighbors=5。

cues.en: Good. Then next parameter, let's see weights = uniforms.
cues.zh: 接著 weights='uniform'。

cues.en: Uniform is the default value of weights and weights is the weight function used in prediction.
cues.zh: uniform 是預設，weights 是預測時的權重函數。

cues.en: And well here, we will actually keep the default value uniform, which means that all the points in each neighborhood are weighted equally.
cues.zh: 保留 uniform，代表鄰域中所有點權重相同。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So they have the same importance.
cues.zh: 重要性相同。

cues.en: So we will keep that, that's fine.
cues.zh: 所以保留。

cues.en: Then algorithm equals auto.
cues.zh: 接著 algorithm='auto'。

cues.en: What does that mean?
cues.zh: 什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, that's basically the algorithm used to compute the nearest neighbors and auto is the best value to choose because it will decide automatically the most appropriate algorithm based
cues.zh: 這是計算最近鄰的演算法。auto 會根據

cues.en: on the values passed to the fit method.
cues.zh: fit 接收的數值，自動選合適演算法。

cues.en: You know, the method that trains your model on the training set.
cues.zh: fit 就是訓練模型的方法。

cues.en: So definitely here it'll be simple if we choose auto and then you have some other parameters leaf size of which will keep the default value, and P which is the power parameter
cues.zh: 選 auto 最簡單，還有 leaf_size，保留預設，以及 p，是

cues.en: for the minkowski metric.
cues.zh: Minkowski 距離的次方參數。

cues.en: So there we go. That's important.
cues.zh: 這很重要。

cues.en: That's the other parameters we will enter.
cues.zh: 是另一個要填的參數。

cues.en: The last two parameters I actually want to enter are this one, metric = minkowski and P.
cues.zh: 最後要填的是 metric='minkowski' 和 p。

cues.en: because indeed metric is actually the distance you want to use to compute, you know, the distance between your observation points and the neighbors.
cues.zh: metric 指定計算觀測點與鄰居之間距離的方法。

cues.en: And we actually want to choose the euclidean distance, which is, you know, the classic distance equal to the square root of the sum of the square differences between the coordinates.
cues.zh: 我們要歐幾里得距離，也就是座標差平方和開根號的經典距離。

cues.en: And in order to take that classic euclidean distance well we have to choose a minkowski metric with p = 2.
cues.zh: 要使用它，選 minkowski 並設 p=2。

cues.en: So basically we're keeping all the default values of this KNeighborsClassifier class, but in order to make sure that we are using them
cues.zh: 所以基本上保留 KNeighborsClassifier 所有預設值，但為確認使用的是這些，

cues.en: and just to highlight them, well, let's just write these parameters with their default values anyway because it's important to see what we're dealing with.
cues.zh: 也為了標示重點，還是明確寫出參數與預設值，讓你知道處理的是什麼。

cues.en: You know, what version of K-NN we are dealing with.
cues.zh: 也就是哪個版本的 KNN。

cues.en: Okay, so let's do this quickly.
cues.zh: 快速完成。

cues.en: Metric = 'minkowski', and then p = 2.
cues.zh: metric='minkowski'，p=2。

cues.en: Perfect. And so now we have basically a classic K nearest neighbors model with five neighbors and a classic euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 很好，現在是五個鄰居、歐幾里得距離的經典 KNN。

cues.en: Okay?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And now you perfectly know how to finish this.
cues.zh: 你應該完全知道如何收尾。

cues.en: The last step here is, of course, to train our class value which indeed we built so far but is not trained yet on the training set.
cues.zh: 當然是在訓練集上訓練剛建立、但尚未訓練的分類器。

cues.en: So that's exactly what we need to do as a final step.
cues.zh: 這就是最後一步。

cues.en: And so there you go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: We call our classifier from which we're gonna call our fit method which, as usual, takes as input first the matrix of feature is X_train,
cues.zh: 使用 classifier 呼叫 fit，一樣先傳入特徵矩陣 X_train，

cues.en: and second the dependent variable vector y_train of the training set, of course.
cues.zh: 再傳入訓練集應變數向量 y_train。

cues.en: All right, perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: You know, we are done with this implementation.
cues.zh: 實作完成了。

cues.en: All the rest is the same.
cues.zh: 其他部分相同。

cues.en: We don't have to change anything else here because indeed since we called our K-NN model classifier.
cues.zh: 不必修改，因為模型叫 classifier。

cues.en: Well, here to make the predictions we already have the right name of the variable classifier.
cues.zh: 預測程式已使用正確的 classifier 名稱。

cues.en: And then same here to predict the tested results classifier.
cues.zh: 預測測試結果也用 classifier。

cues.en: And then same for the confusion matrix, y_test, y_pred which result from our same classifier.
cues.zh: 混淆矩陣使用 y_test、y_pred，同樣來自分類器。

cues.en: And then same for the visualization of the results.
cues.zh: 視覺化也相同。

cues.en: Sorry, I just showed them to you.
cues.zh: 抱歉，剛剛先讓你看到結果。

cues.en: I hope you didn't see but we're gonna get to that in second.
cues.zh: 希望沒被你看到，稍後才介紹。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's the same, same names of the variable classifier, x_train, y_train.
cues.zh: classifier、X_train、y_train 的名稱都相同。

cues.en: So all the rest is the same and that's why I like to call it a good code template.
cues.zh: 所以其他都一樣，這就是好模板。
